REGULAR MEETING AGENDA
CERRITOS PARKS AND RECREATION COMMISSION
THURSDAY - FEBRUARY 6, 2025 - 07:00 P.M.
CERRITOS CITY COUNCIL CHAMBER
18125 BLOOMFIELD AVENUE, CERRITOS, CA 90703
Agenda Materials
The complete agenda for this meeting is available on-demand at cerritos.gov and at the Recreation Services Division, 18125 Bloomfield Avenue, 2nd floor, Cerritos, CA, 90703 during regular business hours (Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., weekend and observed holidays excepted). Any materials submitted to the Commission after distribution of this agenda will be available for public inspection at the Recreation Services Division during regular business hours. Requests for agenda materials or meeting participation assistance can also be made by email to recreation@cerritos.us or by phone at (562) 916-1254 during regular business hours.
Order of Agenda
The Commission, by majority of those members present, may reorder the business items listed on the agenda.
PUBLIC OBSERVATION AND PARTICIPATION
The public can observe the meeting via livestream on the City’s website at cerritos.gov, on cable television at Cerritos TV3, or in person in the Council Chamber.
Public Comments
Members of the public may provide public comment for this meeting in person at the meeting or or in writing as described below.
In-person public comment : Public comment on business agenda items will be opened and may be provided during consideration of that business agenda item. Public comment on Consent Calendar and non-agenda items will be opened and may be provided during Agenda Item No. 5.
Written public comment (hard copy or email) : Public comment may be submitted via email to recreation@cerritos.us or by hard copy to the Recreation Services Division no later than 3:00 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Please identify the agenda item number in the subject line of the email or hard copy document. All written correspondence received by the 3:00 p.m. deadline will be distributed to the Commission prior to the meeting and retained with the official meeting record.
Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) Accommodations
In compliance with the ADA, any person with a disability who requires accommodation in order to participate in a meeting should contact the Recreation Services Division at (562) 916-1254 to request accommodation. The City will use its best efforts to provide reasonable accommodations related to the meeting.

CITY OF CERRITOS
  MINUTES OF A REGULAR MEETING OF THE
  PARKS AND RECREATION COMMISSION
  OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS
  FEBRUARY 6, 2025

1.  Call to Order

  The meeting was called to order at 7:00 p.m.

2.  Pledge of Allegiance
  Vice Chair Prado led in the Pledge of Allegiance.

3.  Roll Call

  PRESENT:  Commissioner David Albright
  Commissioner Steve Lin
  Commissioner Pat Patnaik
  Vice Chair Ileana Prado
  Chair Pino Pathak

  All Members of the Parks and Recreation Commission were declared present.

4.  Presentations
4A.  Presentations

  On behalf of the Parks and Recreation Commission, Chair Pathak recognized
  Employeesof the Month for the Recreation Services Division for November and
  December 2024, Maya Vasquez, Lifeguard/Swim Instructor and Alison Gutierrez,
  Lifeguard/Swim Instructor.
4B.  Informational update on the Tuesday, March 4, 2025 Cerritos General Municipal
  Election

  City Clerk Specialist Kymberly Dobson displayed a PowerPoint presentation with details
  of the March 2025 Municipaland State Elections.

  Discussion followed regarding the location of drop boxes in the City and installation of
  directional signage.

  Chair Pathak invited public comments.

  Adrian Ayub reported he has not received his ballot yet.

  Ms. Dobson noted the date ballots were mailed; suggested the speaker wait a few
  more days and if he has not received his ballot, recommended he contact the City
  Clerk’s Office.

  There were no other public comments on this item and the Chair closed public
  comments.
   Discussionfollowed regarding avoiding duplication of ballots and the process of
  replacing lost ballots.
5.  Public Comments and Suggestions
  Adrian Ayub reported that residents are concerned about people feeding wildlife at Don
  Knabe Park and wondered about the City’s plan for addressing the issue.

  Recreation Services Superintendent Sherr6 Titus announced receiving one emailed
  communication from Mr. Vasudevan with the same concern; reported there is no
  "robust campaign" addressing the topic; referenced an existing policy and efforts to
  communicateto the public not to feed the wildlife; stated the majority of the people
  are compliant; noted there is no plan, at this point, to enhancewhat the City is
  presently doing and hoped people will comply.

  There were no other public comments and the Chair closed public comments and
  suggestions.

  Discussionfollowed regarding the possibility of installing larger signs letting people
  know not to feed the wildlife, increasing the number of signs, the possibility of
  establishing an ordinance, fees for violations and challenges with enforcement.
6.  Consent Calendar

6A.  Approval of Minutes – December 5, 2024, 7:00 p.m. Parks and Recreation Commission
  Regular Meeting Minutes

  MOTION: Commissioner Patnaik moved to approve the Consent Calendar, as
  presented. Vice Chair Prado seconded the motion, which carried 5-0.

7.  Reports
7A.  Reports from Designated Commission Staff Liaison

  Recreation Services Supervisor Jill Toda thanked Cerritos, Whitney and Gahr High
  Schoolsfor partnering with the City by hosting the City’s youth league at the varsity
  basketball games last week and provided an update on Recreation Services programs,
  classes, activities and holiday hours of operation.

  DiscussIonfollowed regarding classes and programs for teenagers and young adults.

  Senior Services Supervisor Jesse Zavala provided an update on Senior Services
  programs, classes and activities.

  Discussion followed regarding upcoming planned field trips.

7B.  Reports from Parks and Recreation Commission Members

  Commissioner Patnaik commented on the recent Festival of Friendship event.

  Vice Chair Pradocommented on activities for children and thanked Superintendent
  Titus for ensuring the installation of the swings at Liberty Park.
